meta.name: testing-oauth2-implementation-flaws
meta.description: Tests OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect implementations for security flaws including authorization code interception, redirect URI manipulation, CSRF in OAuth flows, token leakage, scope escalation, and PKCE bypass. The tester evaluates the authorization server, client application, and token handling for common misconfigurations that enable account takeover or unauthorized access. Activates for requests involving OAuth security testing, OIDC vulnerability assessment, OAuth2 redirect bypass, or authorization code flow testing.

copy.tagline: 检测 OAuth 与 OIDC 实现中的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要评估 OAuth 2.0 和 OpenID Connect 实现的安全性
copy.tagline_en: Detect security flaws in OAuth and OIDC implementations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess the security of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect implementations

howto.what: Claude 可以测试 OAuth 2.0 和 OpenID Connect 实现的安全缺陷，包括授权码拦截、重定向 URI 操纵、CSRF、令牌泄露、范围升级和 PKCE 绕过。它会执行系列步骤并报告漏洞。
howto.when: 当你要求测试 OAuth/OIDC 安全漏洞，或提及重定向绕过、PKCE 绕过、CSRF 保护、范围升级等具体测试时触发。

say.text: 测试这个 OAuth 实现的重定向 URI 验证。
say.note: Claude 会尝试各种重定向绕过载荷。

say.text: 检查 PKCE 是否被强制执行。
say.note: Claude 会发送不带验证器或错误验证器的请求。

say.text: 尝试进行范围升级攻击。
say.note: Claude 会请求更高权限的范围并观察是否被接受。

howto.what_en: Claude can test OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect implementations for security flaws including authorization code interception, redirect URI manipulation, CSRF, token leakage, scope escalation, and PKCE bypass. It runs a series of steps and reports vulnerabilities.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to test OAuth/OIDC security flaws, or mention specific tests like redirect bypass, PKCE bypass, CSRF protection, or scope escalation.

say_en.text: Test the redirect URI validation of this OAuth implementation.
say_en.note: Claude will try various redirect bypass payloads.
Claude will send requests without or with wrong verifier.
Claude will request higher privilege scopes and observe acceptance.
